subject.title: Legacy google provider block fails current model-catalog schema (missing api, input audio/video, cost.cacheWrite) → provider silently unavailable + 120s idle timeout on fallback

question: Which open repair path should become the canonical fix for the legacy Google provider config migration, and should the idle-timeout fallback behavior stay in this issue's landing scope?
rationale: There are multiple open candidate pull requests with different owner-boundary choices and different coverage, so an automated issue sweep should not queue another fix or choose between them without maintainer review.

options.title: Land the complete doctor migration
options.body: Review and land the candidate that repairs all three catalog-schema divergences, then keep or open a narrow follow-up for the idle-timeout behavior if it remains out of scope.

options.title: Move repair to the Google plugin contract
options.body: Ask contributors to converge on a plugin-owned doctor contract migration, but require it to cover input narrowing as well as `api` and `cost.cacheWrite`.

options.title: Replace the competing PRs
options.body: Close the overlapping candidates only after a maintainer-owned replacement PR exists with equivalent migration proof and a clear decision on fallback behavior.

recommendation.title: Land the complete doctor migration
recommendation.body: Review and land the candidate that repairs all three catalog-schema divergences, then keep or open a narrow follow-up for the idle-timeout behavior if it remains out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history and merged PR metadata put this person closest to the affected schema, doctor, and Google plugin contract surfaces.
